body.message:
Please note that the unit was available on all of our online platforms, and as of now, the extension had not been confirmed.

As you know, advance payment is required to secure and block the apartment. Since we had not received any advance payment, the unit was not blocked or reserved in advance.

Unfortunately, the apartment is now only available until the 14th, and we are unable to extend the stay beyond this date.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
